title: Educar para la integración social en condiciones de vulnerabilidad cultural. Una perspectiva relacional y trascendental Educating for Social Integration in Contexts of Cultural Vulnerability. A Relational and Transcendental Perspective
text_snippet: Educar para la integración social en condiciones de vulnerabilidad cultural. Una perspectiva relacional y trascendental Educating for Social Integration in Contexts of Cultural Vulnerability. A Relational and Transcendental Perspective Este artículo propone una reflexión sobre los fundamentos educativos que acompañan la integración de grupos de población vulnerables. La vulnerabilidad se debe a que proceden de culturas diversas a sus contextos de destino, tal como sucede con excombatientes, pospenados o refugiados, entre otros. La discusión se apoya en la Antropología Trascendental de Leonardo Polo; en la Teoría Relacional de la Sociedad, de Pierpaolo Donati, y en la filosofía de la Educación de Altarejos y Naval. Se sugiere la creación de espacios cotidianos de acogida para favorecer la familiarización con las nuevas culturas.

title: Clases latentes de deterioro del bienestar docente en Chile y su asociación con demandas laborales Latent Classes of Teacher Well-Being Deterioration in Chile and Their Links to Job Demands
text_snippet: Clases latentes de deterioro del bienestar docente en Chile y su asociación con demandas laborales Latent Classes of Teacher Well-Being Deterioration in Chile and Their Links to Job Demands Este estudio identificó clases latentes de deterioro del bienestar docente y estimó su asociación con demandas laborales relevantes en el profesorado chileno, utilizando datos de TALIS 2024 (N = 1.360). Los resultados revelaron cuatro clases latentes: bajo deterioro (24,08%), deterioro moderado (38,15%), alto deterioro psicológico (22,58%) y alto deterioro generalizado (15,19%). La pertenencia a las clases de mayor deterioro se asoció con demandas referidas a sobrecarga lectiva, trabajo administrativo y disciplina en el aula. Estos resultados sugieren priorizar en intervenciones ajustadas a la heterogeneidad observada, reducir la sobrecarga estructural y fortalecer apoyos sistémicos en el aula.

title: Educar desde la carencia: una pedagogía de la miserabilidad Teaching from Deficiency: A Pedagogy of Miserability
text_snippet: Educar desde la carencia: una pedagogía de la miserabilidad Teaching from Deficiency: A Pedagogy of Miserability El ser humano es, de manera constitutiva, un animal miserable: deficiente, vulnerable y dependiente. El artículo sostiene que solo asumiendo esa miserabilidad como hecho irreductible cabe una educación formativa y humanista. Frente a las pedagogías del optimismo, y mediante análisis filosófico-hermenéutico, pone en diálogo la antropología de la carencia (Gehlen), la ética de la vulnerabilidad (Levinas, Weil, Butler), la crítica de las pedagogías del rendimiento (Biesta, Han, Nussbaum) y la reivindicación de la scholè como espacio libre de la presión productiva (Masschelein y Simons). Se concluye que una pedagogía de la miserabilidad debe contemplar los límites, la corruptibilidad y la condición voluble del sujeto para reconceptualizar la atención y la responsabilidad ante el otro, abriendo nuevas posibilidades de educar.

title: Perfiles de investigación de las universidades públicas peruanas: estructura multivariada y distribución territorial, 2020-2024 Research Profiles of Peruvian Public Universities: Multivariate Structure and Territorial Distribution, 2020-2024
text_snippet: Perfiles de investigación de las universidades públicas peruanas: estructura multivariada y distribución territorial, 2020-2024 Research Profiles of Peruvian Public Universities: Multivariate Structure and Territorial Distribution, 2020-2024 La concentración del capital humano investigador, el financiamiento de la investigación y la producción científica indexada en el Perú plantea interrogantes sobre la existencia de diferencias entre las universidades públicas peruanas en función de su ubicación geográfica. Este estudio examinó en qué medida la clasificación regional permite describir diferencias territoriales en los perfiles de investigación de 47 universidades públicas peruanas durante 2020-2024. Se aplicó un Análisis de Componentes Principales (ACP) para identificar la estructura multivariada de los perfiles de investigación y una PERMANOVA para evaluar diferencias entre región. El ACP identificó dos dimensiones asociadas, respectivamente, al capital humano investigador y la producción científica indexada y al financiamiento ejecutado. La PERMANOVA mostró que la región explicó el 8,1 % de la variabilidad multivariada, aunque las diferencias entre regiones no fueron significativas. title: Transformación del clima escolar aplicando el modelo PRIMED en colegios públicos de Bogotá School Climate Transformation Through the Implementation of the PRIMED Model in Public Schools in Bogotá
text_snippet: Transformación del clima escolar aplicando el modelo PRIMED en colegios públicos de Bogotá School Climate Transformation Through the Implementation of the PRIMED Model in Public Schools in Bogotá Este estudio longitudinal examinó los cambios en el clima escolar asociados a la implementación del modelo PRIMED (Prioritizing Relationships, Integrity, Modeling, Empowerment y Development). El clima escolar percibido por estudiantes y docentes en diez colegios públicos de Bogotá-Colombia fue medido entre 2023 y 2025. Los análisis revelaron que la apropiación progresiva del principio de modelamiento –coherencia entre discurso y práctica del liderazgo escolar– interactuó significativamente con las trayectorias del clima escolar. El efecto del modelamiento se fortaleció con el tiempo y varió entre colegios, lo que sugiere que la efectividad de PRIMED depende de su implementación contextualizada y del compromiso del liderazgo institucional.

title: Análisis de la satisfacción laboral docente en profesorado de Educación Primaria y Secundaria de centros educativos españoles Analysis of job satisfaction among primary and secondary school teachers in Spanish educational institutions
text_snippet: Análisis de la satisfacción laboral docente en profesorado de Educación Primaria y Secundaria de centros educativos españoles Analysis of job satisfaction among primary and secondary school teachers in Spanish educational institutions En este artículo se presenta el estudio realizado con profesorado de Educación Primaria, Secundaria obligatoria y no obligatoria de centros educativos españoles (N=617) sobre satisfacción laboral docente. Para ello se ha utilizado la Escala de Satisfacción Laboral-Versión para Profesores (ESL-VP) (Anaya y Suárez, 2007). Los resultados obtenidos revelan, de manera general, un nivel de satisfacción medio-alto. Las variables sociodemográficas no predicen la satisfacción laboral docente y la variable más relevante es la titularidad del centro: el profesorado de centros concertados-privados muestra más satisfacción en los aspectos que tienen que ver con el diseño del trabajo o la realización personal, mientras que existe más satisfacción del profesorado de centros públicos en el salario y en condiciones de vida asociadas al trabajo.

title: Collaborative governance in higher-education residential centers: An exploratory mixed-methods study on character development potential
text_snippet: Collaborative governance in higher-education residential centers: An exploratory mixed-methods study on character development potential This study explores collaborative governance in highereducation residential centers as a means to promote character development. Its aim is to analyze how this practice is designed and implemented, the challenges it faces, and the opportunities it offers. A mixed-methods questionnaire was administered to directors of 35 centers across six countries. Results show that, although collaborative governance is common, it rarely relies on evidence-based pedagogical models or systematic assessment. Findings reveal training gaps, limited student participation in key decisions, and opportunities to strengthen character development through intentional, research-informed governance design.

title: Understanding School Satisfaction among Immigrant Students: The Influence of Cultural Dissonance and Cultural Self-Efficacy
text_snippet: Understanding School Satisfaction among Immigrant Students: The Influence of Cultural Dissonance and Cultural Self-Efficacy Rising immigration levels have notably impacted the Chilean education system, stressing the importance of understanding the cultural and psychological factors that shape immigrant students’ school experiences. This cross-sectional study examined the relationships between cultural dissonance, cultural self-efficacy, and school satisfaction among 236 Latin-American immigrant secondary students. Cultural dissonance showed an adverse effect on school satisfaction by diminishing students’ cultural self-efficacy. Sociodemographic variables such as sex, nationality, age, and length of stay in Chile had no impact on students’ satisfaction with school. These findings underscore the importance of cultivating culturally responsive educational communities that foster the development of intercultural competencies.

title: Educar para prevenir la ciberagresión en adolescentes: eficacia de dos programas breves en inteligencia emocional y psicoeducación Educating to prevent cyberaggression in adolescents: Effectiveness of two brief programmes in emotional intelligence and psychoeducation
text_snippet: Educar para prevenir la ciberagresión en adolescentes: eficacia de dos programas breves en inteligencia emocional y psicoeducación Educating to prevent cyberaggression in adolescents: Effectiveness of two brief programmes in emotional intelligence and psychoeducation El estudio “Educar para prevenir la ciberagresión en adolescentes: eficacia de dos programas breves en inteligencia emocional y psicoeducación” tenía como objetivo analizar la eficacia de dos programas breves en inteligencia emocional (IE) y psicoeducación. Para ello, se empleó un diseño cuasiexperimental de medidas repetidas con seguimiento, sin grupo control. Participaron 251 adolescentes asignados a uno de los programas. La ciberagresión se evaluó pre, post y a los tres meses. Se observaron reducciones significativas del tamaño de efecto de pequeño a mediano: en psicoeducación en la post-intervención y en IE en el seguimiento. La interacción grupo x tiempo no fue significativa en el ANOVA factorial mixto. Los resultados apoyan el potencial preventivo de ambos enfoques.

title: La educación cristiana en la época moderna: fundamentos para un redescubrimiento de la fe desde el pensamiento y experiencia de Luigi Giussani Christian Education in the Modern Age: Foundations for a Rediscovery of Faith from the Thought and Experience of Luigi Giussani
text_snippet: La educación cristiana en la época moderna: fundamentos para un redescubrimiento de la fe desde el pensamiento y experiencia de Luigi Giussani Christian Education in the Modern Age: Foundations for a Rediscovery of Faith from the Thought and Experience of Luigi Giussani This article aims to elucidate the foundational principles required for an authentic education in faith within the context of modernity, as derived from the thought and pedagogical experience of Luigi Giussani. It begins by examining the key characteristics of this educational approach as articulated by the Italian pedagogue at the outset of his teaching activity at the Berchet Lyceum. It then analyzes the development and implications of these characteristics. The analysis is confined to Giussani’s educational texts, both theoretical and testimonial. The conclusion highlights the relevance of his pedagogical insights for sustaining an educational tradition rooted in the life of the Church amid the secular milieu in which contemporary youth find themselves.

title: El estudiante silencioso y su incidencia en la intención de abandono académico del alumnado de Grado de la Universidad de La Laguna The Silent Student and Its Impact on the Academic Dropout Intentions of Undergraduate Students at the University of La Laguna
text_snippet: El estudiante silencioso y su incidencia en la intención de abandono académico del alumnado de Grado de la Universidad de La Laguna The Silent Student and Its Impact on the Academic Dropout Intentions of Undergraduate Students at the University of La Laguna El abandono académico universitario constituye un desafío relevante debido a sus repercusiones tanto en el desarrollo del estudiantado como en la eficiencia del sistema de educación superior. En el contexto español, las tasas de abandono se sitúan entre el 30% y el 40%, lo que pone de manifiesto la necesidad de identificar nuevos factores explicativos. Este estudio analiza la influencia del perfil de estudiante silencioso en la intención de abandono universitario. Mediante un diseño empírico-analítico de tipo ex post facto, se administró un cuestionario a una muestra de 524 estudiantes pertenecientes a diversas titulaciones de la Universidad de La Laguna. Los resultados evidencian que los estudiantes con este perfil presentan una mayor predisposición al abandono, vinculada a variables como la baja motivación, la frustración ante los resultados académicos, el desinterés por la titulación, la presencia de dificultades emocionales y la percepción negativa de la metodología docente. title: Psychometric properties of the ultra-short measure Utrecht Work Engagement Scale for Students (UWES-3S): Validity and Reliability in the Spanish online university context
text_snippet: Psychometric properties of the ultra-short measure Utrecht Work Engagement Scale for Students (UWES-3S): Validity and Reliability in the Spanish online university context To addresses the lack of brief, validated tools to assess student engagement in online universities, the present study examined the psychometric properties of the UWES-3S in a sample of 394 online students (72.8% women). Results demonstrated a one-factor structure with good internal consistency (α = .81), and test-retest (.80). Rasch analyses indicated an appropriate scale functioning, item difficulty distribution, and minimal gender-related bias. title: Relación entre la autoeficacia académica y la dependencia hacia la Inteligencia Artificial en estudiantes de carreras de formación docente Relationship between academic self-efficacy and dependence on Artificial Intelligence in students enrolled in teacher training programs
text_snippet: Relación entre la autoeficacia académica y la dependencia hacia la Inteligencia Artificial en estudiantes de carreras de formación docente Relationship between academic self-efficacy and dependence on Artificial Intelligence in students enrolled in teacher training programs This study analyzes the relationship between academic selfefficacy and dependence on artificial intelligence (AI) in teacher education students. title: Factores promotores de la implicación escolar del alumnado y su relación con las estrategias de personalización del aprendizaje Factors that promote student engagement and their relations with learning personalisation strategies
text_snippet: Factores promotores de la implicación escolar del alumnado y su relación con las estrategias de personalización del aprendizaje Factors that promote student engagement and their relations with learning personalisation strategies Student engagement in school activities is a crucial factor for their academic success, however, there are still doubts about which personal and contextual factors influence this engagement. We implemented an ad hoc questionnaire that we administered to 2737 students from 14 schools in Catalonia, with different features according to their ownership, stage, and socioeconomic level, and we analysed data with descriptive and statistical analysis (ANOVA, Student-T, Mann- Whitney-U, and Kruskal-Wallis tests). The results show that levels of school engagement depend on gender, age, and other personal and contextual variables, and that personalisation strategies are key. Conclusions offer guidelines for teachers to promote learning of greater value and personal meaning for students.

title: Effects on an Educational Mediation in a Centre of Juvenile Offenders to Improve Their Behaviour
text_snippet: Effects on an Educational Mediation in a Centre of Juvenile Offenders to Improve Their Behaviour Introduction: The objective is to determine whether a juvenile facility contributes to the improvement of social skills and the reduction of aggressive or violent behaviours in juvenile offenders. Method: A quasi-experimental pretest-posttest quantitative design was used, applied to n= 40 individuals. Three pretest/posttest instruments were administered to this sample to determine whether a juvenile facility contributes to the improvement of social skills and the reduction of aggressive or violent behaviour. title: Percepción del profesorado universitario sobre la frecuencia y gravedad de prácticas deshonestas en la investigación University teachers' perceptions about the frequency and severity of academic misconduct in research
text_snippet: Percepción del profesorado universitario sobre la frecuencia y gravedad de prácticas deshonestas en la investigación University teachers' perceptions about the frequency and severity of academic misconduct in research This study addresses the vision of university faculty on ethics and academic integrity in research. The aim is to find out their perception regarding the frequency and severity of certain academic misconduct in research and to check differences by areas of knowledge and years of experience. A questionnaire was applied to 243 professors from Galician universities, the results of which show a low assessment of the frequency of certain conducts and a high estimate of the severity of other actions, highlighting the need to design educational strategies focused on training on ethics and integrity, aimed especially at teaching and research staff.

title: La inclusión del alumnado con Trastorno del Espectro Autista: los desafíos del profesorado para una educación inclusiva. Una revisión sistemática The inclusión of students with ASD: barriers, limitations and difficulties for teacher towars inclusive education. A systematic review
text_snippet: La inclusión del alumnado con Trastorno del Espectro Autista: los desafíos del profesorado para una educación inclusiva. Una revisión sistemática The inclusión of students with ASD: barriers, limitations and difficulties for teacher towars inclusive education. A systematic review The aim was to review the literature on barriers to inclusion of students with ASD from the perspective of teachers. In addition, it was assessed whether there are differences in the perception of barriers depending on the type of subject, differentiating between those subjects that are taught in the classroom and Physical Education classes. After the search process, 14 studies that met the inclusion criteria were included. According to the findings, the challenges can be classified into 3 categories related to autism symptoms, administrative and social. The participants add a series of challenges according to the pedagogical discipline.

title: Ideación de abandono universitario, principales motivos y su relación con el compromiso académico: un análisis en España y Bolivia University dropout ideation, main reasons, and its relationship with academic engagement: an analysis in Spain and Bolivia
text_snippet: Ideación de abandono universitario, principales motivos y su relación con el compromiso académico: un análisis en España y Bolivia University dropout ideation, main reasons, and its relationship with academic engagement: an analysis in Spain and Bolivia University dropout is a global challenge, affecting 21% of students according to the OECD. Objective. To assess dropout ideation, its main motivations, and the potential relationship with academic engagement. Method. 627 students from universities in Spain and Bolivia were evaluated using an ad hoc instrument for dropout ideation and the engagement scale by López-Aguilar et al. (2021). Results. 30.6% showed intermediate dropout ideation and 14.4% high ideation, influenced by psychological factors in Spain and socio-economic factors in Bolivia, with no significant relationship with engagement. Conclusion. Further exploration of the phenomenon is needed, considering other instruments and sociodemographic variables.

title: Does a psychoeducational programme promote social-emotional development in Spanish six- year-old students regardless of gender?
text_snippet: Does a psychoeducational programme promote social-emotional development in Spanish six- year-old students regardless of gender? Social-emotional learning promotes positive development. A six-session programme was conducted to identify social-emotional changes among 83 students (meanage = 6 years). Self-reported and parent- reported pre- and post-test measures were used: a fluency task of naming emotions evaluated emotional awareness, the Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire measured emotional regulation and relational skills, and the Behaviour Assessment System for Children-Parent Rating Scale assessed relational skills. Implementation was evaluated at the end of each session. Regardless of gender, children’s emotional awareness and regulation, relational skills, and wellbeing improved. Emotional symptoms decreased compared to a control group of a previous research. Despite the lack of a concurrent control group and the small sample size, this study introduces the evaluation of a programme worthy of further development.

title: Conceptualización del absentismo escolar en España: una visión cualitativa de las normativas autonómicas Conceptualization of School Absenteeism in Spain: A Qualitative View of Regional Regulations
text_snippet: Conceptualización del absentismo escolar en España: una visión cualitativa de las normativas autonómicas Conceptualization of School Absenteeism in Spain: A Qualitative View of Regional Regulations School absenteeism in Spain is a complex phenomenon to define, conceptualized differently across various regional regulations. This study aims to explore, from a dimensional perspective, how these regulations conceptualize absenteeism through a qualitative approach using content analysis. The results reveal variability in definitions, identifying convergences in the inclusion of quantitative indicators and divergences in the consideration of antecedent behaviors of absenteeism, as well as its intermittent presence. The findings highlight the existence of various regional intervention initiatives, although a national framework could foster the standardization of interventions and optimization of outcomes.

title: Actitudes y criterios de orientación académica del profesorado tutor y orientador en Educación Secundaria Obligatoria Attitudes and criteria for academic orientation of tutors and academic counsellors in Compulsory Secondary Education
text_snippet: Actitudes y criterios de orientación académica del profesorado tutor y orientador en Educación Secundaria Obligatoria Attitudes and criteria for academic orientation of tutors and academic counsellors in Compulsory Secondary Education The study aims to explore the characteristics of tutors and guidance counselors for 3rd and 4th grade of compulsory Secondary Education based on their attitudes and level of knowledge about guidance, and the criteria they use for academic and career advising. A quantitative, descriptive and correlational approach was adopted, using an ad hoc questionnaire directed at teachers (N=697) from Andalusia, Asturias, Catalonia, and Madrid. The main results show that guidance actions are determined to a greater extent by attitudes towards the counselling function rather than by the teaching role.

title: Perfiles motivacionales y éxito escolar en Secundaria: un enfoque centrado en la persona Motivational Profiles and Secondary School Success: A Person-Centred Approach
text_snippet: Perfiles motivacionales y éxito escolar en Secundaria: un enfoque centrado en la persona Motivational Profiles and Secondary School Success: A Person-Centred Approach This study identifies motivational profiles based on combinations of academic goals, whose distribution is analyzed by gender and academic level, and examines differences in academic achievement in Spanish, English and Mathematics. With 730 ESO students and using Latent Profile Analysis (LPA), five different profiles were detected that vary in the combination and intensity of goals. Significant differences were found in the distribution of these profiles by gender and course, and in academic achievement. The profiles which integrate learning goals and performance approaches, together with the profile focused exclusively on learning goals, emerge as the most adaptive.

title: Predicción de la deserción académica mediante aprendizaje automático supervisado: el caso de una universidad chilena Prediction of Academic Dropout Using Supervised Machine Learning: The Case of a Chilean University
text_snippet: Predicción de la deserción académica mediante aprendizaje automático supervisado: el caso de una universidad chilena Prediction of Academic Dropout Using Supervised Machine Learning: The Case of a Chilean University La deserción estudiantil es una preocupación constante en la educación superior chilena, con efectos en la equidad y eficiencia del sistema. Este estudio analizó datos de 17.816 estudiantes de una universidad chilena (2020-2023) para predecir el abandono, aplicando técnicas de aprendizaje automático. El modelo logró un 87,2 % de acierto al aplicarse a la cohorte 2024. Los factores más influyentes fueron el avance curricular, el promedio de notas, la carrera y el campus. Estos resultados permiten anticipar la deserción con precisión y generar alertas tempranas, lo que contribuye al diseño de intervenciones más efectivas para mejorar la retención estudiantil.

title: Dealing with discouragement in the teaching career: examining teachers’ experiences and coping strategies in a private Mexican university
text_snippet: Dealing with discouragement in the teaching career: examining teachers’ experiences and coping strategies in a private Mexican university This study explores teachers’ experiences associated with discouragement in regard to their teaching careers and the strategies they use to cope with this perceived discouragement. Participants were 318 Mexican university teachers. Data was collected through and online questionnaire with open-ended questions. Through a mixedmethod analysis, results show that teachers’ discouraging experiences were related to Teaching practices and Working environment. Among those two main categories, six subcategories were identified. Notably, teachers’ effective coping mechanisms do not always become more effective with experience, and thus, different kinds of support are needed to help teachers manage challenging emotional experiences.

title: Validación del Cuestionario de Evaluación de Estrategias de Aprendizaje en Estudiantes Universitarios (CEVEAPEU): Propiedades psicométricas en Argentina Validation of the Questionnaire for the Assessment of Learning Strategies in University Students (CEVEAPEU): Psychometric properties in Argentina
text_snippet: Validación del Cuestionario de Evaluación de Estrategias de Aprendizaje en Estudiantes Universitarios (CEVEAPEU): Propiedades psicométricas en Argentina Validation of the Questionnaire for the Assessment of Learning Strategies in University Students (CEVEAPEU): Psychometric properties in Argentina The objective of the study was to analyze the psychometric properties of the Learning Strategies Assessment Questionnaire for University Students (CEVEAPEU) in an Argentine population. The study included 3,403 participants. Exploratory factor analysis suggested a structure of 26 learning strategies. Confirmatory factor analyses revealed that a model with 26 correlated strategies provided the best fit. Evidence of criterion validity was also reported (relationships with academic performance and personality traits), and good reliability indices were obtained. The results support the use of the CEVEAPEU as a valid and reliable tool, while also highlighting the need for specific adjustments.

title: Procesos interactivos y co-construcción de la colaboración entre tutores de universidad y escuela en un prácticum reflexivo Interactive processes and co-construction of collaboration between university and school tutors through a reflexive practicum
text_snippet: Procesos interactivos y co-construcción de la colaboración entre tutores de universidad y escuela en un prácticum reflexivo Interactive processes and co-construction of collaboration between university and school tutors through a reflexive practicum From a sociocultural perspective, the article deals with the study of interactive processes in collaborative spaces between university and school tutors in a reflective practicum. It analyses how two dyads of tutors, with and without previous experience of mutual collaboration, structure their joint activity, and through it, shape their own collaboration and the monitoring of student learning. The results show some differences in the way the two dyads share and co-construct the training proposal, the relationship between tutors, the assessment of learning and feedback. Some implications for the improvement of the collaboration in the practicum are provided.

title: Más allá y más acá de la educación inclusiva. Crítica y expansión de su concepto Going beyond and deeper into inclusive education. A critique and development of the concept
text_snippet: Más allá y más acá de la educación inclusiva. Crítica y expansión de su concepto Going beyond and deeper into inclusive education. A critique and development of the concept The article critically analyses the current conception of inclusive education and proposes a broader model that includes attention to student diversity and identity, an inclusive curriculum in terms of paradigms, approaches, and techniques considering diversity among teachers, and an inclusive curriculum related to teaching domains. The concept of “meaningful inclusive education” is also introduced, which acknowledges the uniqueness of each student and challenges the idea that schooling in mainstream settings should be a first-order principle for all. This perspective may contribute to expanding the concept of inclusive education.

title: Estudio de factores sociodemográficos asociados a la inequidad educativa en la Educación Secundaria en España. Un análisis de las pruebas PISA Study of Socio-Demographic Factors associated with Educational Inequality in Secondary Education in Spain. An analysis of PISA Tests
text_snippet: Estudio de factores sociodemográficos asociados a la inequidad educativa en la Educación Secundaria en España. Un análisis de las pruebas PISA Study of Socio-Demographic Factors associated with Educational Inequality in Secondary Education in Spain. An analysis of PISA Tests Developed societies are characterised by an increase in social inequalities, and studies focused on analysing levels of educational inequality such as this one are necessary. Based on the PISA 2018 tests, these differences are analysed in 976 Spanish schools, detecting that despite the fact that schools have greater socioeconomic homogeneity than other countries, there are key factors associated with inequality such as high student-teacher ratios, the socioeconomic composition of the school or its ownership. It concludes by highlighting the need to implement concrete strategies to reduce school inequalities and promote quality education for all.

title: Impacto de la inteligencia emocional y del clima escolar sobre el bienestar subjetivo y los síntomas emocionales en la adolescencia Impact of emotional intelligence and school climate on subjective well-being and emotional symptoms in adolescence
text_snippet: Impacto de la inteligencia emocional y del clima escolar sobre el bienestar subjetivo y los síntomas emocionales en la adolescencia Impact of emotional intelligence and school climate on subjective well-being and emotional symptoms in adolescence Adolescence is a period of change that can affect mental health if not managed properly. Developing emotional intelligence skills helps to experience greater well-being and fewer emotional symptoms. Of particular interest is the role of classroom climate in fostering these resources in the school context. The present research examines the association between emotional intelligence, emotional symptomatology and subjective well-being, considering the mediating role of school climate. A total of 356 adolescents between the ages of 12 and 16 (M= 13.52; 58% female) participated in the study, who completed the following self-report instruments: Escala Rasgo de Metaconocimientos sobre Estados Emocionales (TMMS), Satisfaction with Life Scale (SWLS), Questionnaire to Assess School Social Climate (CECSCE), Positive and Negative Experiences Scale (SPANE), Depression, Anxiety and Stress Scale for Youth (DASS-Y). The results showed that high levels of emotional intelligence, together with a favourable school climate, have a positive impact on subjective well-being and have a negative influence on symptoms of depression, anxiety and stress. title: Las funciones ejecutivas y la salud mental en el contexto educativo Executive functions and mental health in the educational context
text_snippet: Las funciones ejecutivas y la salud mental en el contexto educativo Executive functions and mental health in the educational context Mental health problems are posing a difficulty in school development due to their influence on Executive Functions (EF). The aim was to analyse, in the educational context, the effect that anxiety and depression can have on EF. The sample consisted of 689 young people aged between ten and fourteen years (M= 11.89; SD= 1.38). Three self-report instruments were used for a Latent Class Analysis (LCA), the results of which showed the three-class model to be the best. In conclusion, educational interventions that include the mitigation of manifestations of anxiety and/or depression would prevent problems in EF.

title: Explorando la relación entre ansiedad estado, género y rendimiento académico en estudiantes de educación secundaria Exploring the relationship between state anxiety, gender, and academic performance in secondary school students
text_snippet: Explorando la relación entre ansiedad estado, género y rendimiento académico en estudiantes de educación secundaria Exploring the relationship between state anxiety, gender, and academic performance in secondary school students The relationship between state anxiety and academic performance was analyzed in a study involving 344 Spanish secondary school students (M= 13.66; SD= 1.184). The sample consisted of a balanced proportion of boys (49%) and girls (51%) from two educational institutions -one public and one semi-private. To examine gender differences and evaluate both direct and interactive effects, Mann-Whitney U tests and linear regression analyses were conducted. The STAI state anxiety scale was utilized alongside average grades for this analysis. The results indicated a significant negative correlation between state anxiety and academic performance. Additionally, girls exhibited noticeably higher levels of state anxiety compared to boys. The study also revealed both direct and interactive effects of gender and anxiety on academic performance. These findings underscore the importance of addressing anxiety in secondary education, emphasizing the need for initiatives that focus on developing emotional competencies.

title: Factores psicosociales y su relación con el logro educativo en estudiantes de bachillerato en México Psychosocial factors and their relationship with academic achievement in high school students in Mexico
text_snippet: Factores psicosociales y su relación con el logro educativo en estudiantes de bachillerato en México Psychosocial factors and their relationship with academic achievement in high school students in Mexico Undoubtedly, it is a priority to work in favor of the educational achievement of students who attend high school, therefore, it is important to know the psychosocial factors related to it. The objective of this research was to establish the relationship that exists between cooperation, school belongings, bullying, emotional distress and adaptability with educational achievement in this population group. For this, the public database of the Program for International Student Assessment (PISA) was used. A total of 7,299 students from Mexico participated, aged between 15.33 and 16.33 years. A theoretical model was developed empirically verified through structural equation modeling. A relationship was demonstrated between each of the factors analyzed with educational achievement. Therefore, teacher and family participation, under the guidelines of the factors mentioned, are a key piece in the academic field of the Mexican country.

title: Calidad de las interacciones en la lectura de cuentos en el hogar Quality of Read Aloud Interactions at Home
text_snippet: Calidad de las interacciones en la lectura de cuentos en el hogar Quality of Read Aloud Interactions at Home The purpose of this study was to explore the quality of verbal interactions of 8 mother-child dyads from low-income homes. These interactions took place in the context of a shared reading training for parents and caregivers. From a micro-analytical approach, we examined 163 IRS sequences (onset-response-follow-up) that took place in 24 video-recorded sessions at the beginning, middle, and end of the shared reading training. Results show that closed, onset questions are predominant across the interactions. These questions lead to literal comprehension and follow-up interactions that are characterized by low cognitive demands. No changes were observed over time.

title: Efecto del interés hacia los contenidos, valor atribuido a las tareas, control sobre el aprendizaje y procrastinación en la autorregulación académica de estudiantes universitarios Effect of interest in content, value attributed to tasks, control over learning and procrastination on academic self-regulation in university students
text_snippet: Efecto del interés hacia los contenidos, valor atribuido a las tareas, control sobre el aprendizaje y procrastinación en la autorregulación académica de estudiantes universitarios Effect of interest in content, value attributed to tasks, control over learning and procrastination on academic self-regulation in university students Introduction: among the skills that comprehensive education seeks to promote is self-regulation, therefore, the objective was to analyze the effect that self-regulation receives from the independent variables: interest in the contents, value attributed to the tasks, control over the learning and procrastination. Materials and method: a quantitative study was carried out with a sample of 505 university students from northern Sonora (México). Results: the resulting model includes all the proposed independent variables, explaining 36% of academic self-regulation. Discussion: it is essential to continue the study and promotion of self-regulatory strategies of university students.

title: Percepciones del estudiantado sobre el «feedback» sostenible: un análisis de redes en una universidad española Student perceptions of sustainable «feedback»: a network analysis at a Spanish university
text_snippet: Percepciones del estudiantado sobre el «feedback» sostenible: un análisis de redes en una universidad española Student perceptions of sustainable «feedback»: a network analysis at a Spanish university The study aims to describe feedback practices at a Spanish university and analyse their alignment with the principles of sustainable feedback. Data were collected from 261 students through an online questionnaire. In addition to descriptive analyses, a psychometric network analysis was conducted to capture the dynamic and interactive nature of sustainable feedback. The results indicate that, while students interact with various sources and demonstrate efforts towards self-regulation, faculty members play a central role in feedback practices. These findings underscore the importance of intensifying efforts to promote sustainable feedback.

title: Factores asociados a la intención de abandonar los estudios superiores: la motivación y la resiliencia Factors associated with intention to drop out of higher education: motivation and resilience
text_snippet: Factores asociados a la intención de abandonar los estudios superiores: la motivación y la resiliencia Factors associated with intention to drop out of higher education: motivation and resilience To explore the complexity of dropout, the joint effects of motivation and resilience on transfer and dropout intentions are analysed. Using a sample of 477 Spanish students, t-tests and logistic regression models were applied. Multivariate results indicate that intrinsic motivation and amotivation explain 44.4% of transfer intentions and intrinsic motivation, external regulation and amotivation explain 48.1% of dropout intentions. These high percentages suggest that fostering intrinsic motivation and preventing amotivation are essential to reduce dropout rates.

title: Educar en virtudes a través de la literatura: narrativa, imaginación y deseo Educating in Virtues through Literature: Narrative, Imagination and Desire
text_snippet: Educar en virtudes a través de la literatura: narrativa, imaginación y deseo Educating in Virtues through Literature: Narrative, Imagination and Desire This article examines, from a philosophical and educational perspective, the use of literature as an indispensable means in character and virtues education. By addressing various levels of imagination, it highlights how literature can influence the desire for a moral and universal understanding of the world and in the cultural challenges expand in this crucial moment. The emphasis here is on the presentation of attractive and virtuous role models as essential for personal growth, as these exemplary characters can inspire readers to cultivate virtues such as prudence, diligence, and moral use of moral imagination. Through its captivating narratives, literature can foster a deep and more meaningful personal and social flourishing.

title: El estudio de la experiencia escolar. Propuesta de un modelo de análisis interdisciplinario The study of the school experience. Proposal of an interdisciplinary analysis model
text_snippet: El estudio de la experiencia escolar. Propuesta de un modelo de análisis interdisciplinario The study of the school experience. Proposal of an interdisciplinary analysis model The objective of the article is to develop a model for the study of the school experience. In this direction, and as a methodological procedure, we discuss the assumptions coming from different disciplines –such as those of the “pedagogy of experience”, the “sociology of experience” or “biographical approaches”– in three central analytical axes: structure/subject relationship, exceptionality/everyday life and experience/meaning. After this exercise, we propose an interdisciplinary model for the study of the school experience that integrates the axes under discussion, weighing their conceptual, procedural and analytical implications.

title: PIRLS 2021. Factores relacionados con el rendimiento lector en Educación Primaria en España PIRLS 2021. Factors related to reading performance in Primary Education in Spain
text_snippet: PIRLS 2021. Factores relacionados con el rendimiento lector en Educación Primaria en España PIRLS 2021. Factors related to reading performance in Primary Education in Spain This article aims to analyse the related factors of students on reading performance. The sample is composed of 8,551 students in year 4 of primary education (52.1% boys, 47.9% girls). A Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) was carried out and a multilevel model was calculated on PIRLS student questionnaire comprising 28 items. The results show the interrelationship between the five factors with the greatest influence on performance: students’ attitude towards reading, students’ wellbeing at school, the quality of teaching, students’ reading difficulties and reading self-efficacy.

title: Caracterización psicométrica de la prueba de procrastinación PASS en alumnos de educación secundaria colombianos Instrument to assess procrastination in high school: a validation study
text_snippet: Caracterización psicométrica de la prueba de procrastinación PASS en alumnos de educación secundaria colombianos Instrument to assess procrastination in high school: a validation study Among high school students, academic procrastination is frequent, affecting their school performance, health, and well-being. We validate the Spanish version of the Procrastination Assessment Scale- Students, which evaluates the frequency and reasons to procrastinate. Four hundred fifty-one high school students from Bogotá (Colombia) participated. Content validity discriminant analyses and statistics are performed according to the Rasch model. We found good item fit to the Rasch model, good reliability of the measures and persons, without DIF by gender; we also found significant negative associations regarding self-regulation and performance of the participants.
